rules.guidance: Map selected values to semantic project tokens; do not replace an existing project token system wholesale.
rejectWhen: project design tokens already express the required role and migration has no measured benefit

rules.guidance: Use motion to explain state change, hierarchy, or direction and retain a complete non-motion state.
rejectWhen: the component already contains a competing movement

rules.guidance: Put dense or variable text on a solid or translucent content surface and keep the background decorative.
rejectWhen: high-intensity decoration sits directly behind body copy

rules.guidance: Use one primary decorative layer and simplify or remove masks on narrow or constrained devices.
rejectWhen: multiple medium-cost full-surface compositing effects are stacked

rules.guidance: Reduce shadow spread and layer count when the host surface already has visible texture or glow.
rejectWhen: heavy shadows compete with a dense surface

rules.guidance: Choose one motion role per interaction moment and share duration and easing tokens.
rejectWhen: entrance, pulse, and hover movement run on the same element without a functional reason

rules.guidance: Reduce movement, blur, pattern density, and decorative layers on narrow screens while preserving content and state.
rejectWhen: a fallback is required but not implemented
